snippet.title: HACHIKOMA | Anime Spinning-Top Battles Meet Anomaly Horror | Gameplay Preview
snippet.description:
Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5394170/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer&utm_campaign=hachikoma_202610

If something is wrong, turn back. If everything looks normal, win a spinning-top battle and move forward. Can you reach Exit 8?

HACHIKOMA: Underground Stadium No. 8 combines anime-style spinning-top battles with anomaly detection in a looping underground passage. Customize your top, watch for over 40 anomalies, and challenge the champion.

Planned Steam release: October 30, 2026.
Windows PC. Japanese voices; check the Steam page for supported text languages.
The Steam page lists a Twitch voting mode, asymmetric co-op with a friend watching security cameras from a mobile browser, and local two-player versus.

Gameplay trailer preview supplied by ISEKAI Games.
Explore all 14 ISEKAI Games on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/curator/46305610-ISEKAI-Games/list/179469/?utm_source=youtube&utm_medium=trailer&utm_campaign=catalog14_202610
More official trailers: https://www.youtube.com/playlist?list=PLLmgggpwKpWQ

AI-assisted programming, visual assets and creative elements are used in the game, as disclosed on its Steam page.
